title.narrative: Support to the Forest Observatory of Eastern and Southern Africa OFESA

description.narrative: By providing reliable data on forest cover and other major environmental trends, OFESA will support national and regional level tracking of performance under several obligations such as the Paris Agreement and AFR 100. The OFESA will be directly linked to on-going related activities and projects (such as Biopama and GMES-Africa).
